decisions.label: comprehension monitoring
decisions.reason: Comprehension monitoring is plausible but crosses C1/C6 metacognition/comprehension boundaries; requires dedicated construct evidence.

decisions.label: memory-priority allocation
decisions.reason: Memory-priority allocation is too broad/underspecified for canonical promotion.

decisions.label: behavioral approach-inhibition tendency
decisions.reason: Behavioral approach/inhibition tendency risks collapsing trait systems with state approach/avoidance nodes already accepted.

decisions.label: costly signaling
decisions.reason: Costly signaling requires economics/evolutionary/social-signaling evidence and boundary separation from status/reputation.

decisions.label: behavioral social proof
decisions.reason: Behavioral social proof substantially overlaps accepted descriptive norm/social consensus constructs; requires nonredundancy proof.

decisions.label: consensus diagnosticity
decisions.reason: Consensus diagnosticity is plausible but needs explicit evidence distinguishing cue prevalence from perceived diagnosticity.

decisions.label: option ordering
decisions.reason: Option ordering is a choice-architecture manipulation family, not yet a single stable psychological construct.

decisions.label: choice-set partitioning
decisions.reason: Choice-set partitioning requires dedicated context/partition evidence before node promotion.

decisions.label: future-self continuity
decisions.reason: Future-self continuity is relevant to intertemporal choice but needs focused construct/measurement evidence.

decisions.label: temporal construal
decisions.reason: Temporal construal requires focused construal-level evidence and boundary work against temporal discounting.

decisions.label: contextual range evaluation
decisions.reason: Contextual range evaluation may overlap relative evaluation/contrast; nonredundancy not yet established.

decisions.label: source-track-record evaluation
decisions.reason: Source-track-record evaluation overlaps provisional C5-N03-04 Source Reliability Track Record.

decisions.label: resistance motivation
decisions.reason: Resistance motivation is broader than accepted counterarguing/reactance/inoculation nodes and needs construct-specific evidence.

decisions.label: selective message avoidance
decisions.reason: Selective message avoidance is plausible but needs direct avoidance evidence and boundaries against information avoidance/reactance.

decisions.label: diagnostic proof cue
decisions.reason: Diagnostic proof cue overlaps C5 evidence diagnosticity plus provisional proof-design nodes; canonical nonredundancy not established.

decisions.label: pragmatic politeness
decisions.reason: Pragmatic politeness is established broadly but needs a scoped taxonomy suitable for copywriting without collapsing multiple politeness theories.

decisions.label: implicature cancellation/revision
decisions.reason: Cancellation/revision is better treated as a property/process of implicature unless evidence supports a distinct runtime node.

decisions.label: idiom processing
decisions.reason: Idiom processing is scientifically valid but lower runtime criticality; defer until C6 depth expansion.

decisions.label: metonymic interpretation
decisions.reason: Metonymic interpretation is valid but requires dedicated figurative-language evidence.

decisions.label: figurative framing
decisions.reason: Figurative framing overlaps metaphor/figurative meaning plus C4/C7 framing; requires clear primary mechanism.

decisions.label: tone/persona realization
decisions.reason: Tone/persona realization is an applied language-design family that needs decomposition by linguistic features and social meaning.

decisions.label: progressive disclosure
decisions.reason: Progressive disclosure is a design pattern; causal persuasion evidence is insufficient for canonical effect claims.

decisions.label: evidence timing
decisions.reason: Evidence timing is a design variable whose effects depend on order, source cues and elaboration.

decisions.label: categorical juxtaposition
decisions.reason: Categorical juxtaposition overlaps accepted contrast/comparative structure unless a distinct mechanism is demonstrated.

decisions.label: counterargument sequencing
decisions.reason: Counterargument sequencing is a design variable; message-sidedness/refutation constructs already cover core structure.

decisions.label: temporal immediacy of request
decisions.reason: Temporal immediacy of request is a CTA design variable requiring direct behavioral evidence and interaction with delay/friction/reactance.
